protocol.prompt_transport: utf-8 stdin or a prepared prompt file
protocol.result_transport: one utf-8 final-answer file per case and repetition
protocol.logs: must remain separate from the final answer
protocol.source_policy: the adapter passes the frozen source without summarizing or translating it
protocol.runtime_init: the adapter must create and lock a task contract plus generated task bundle and module manifest before generation
protocol.semantic_review_binding: the adapter must bind the still-pending semantic and runtime-rule review to the exact artifact and content snapshot, retain the separate binding receipt locked into the task contract, and only then complete review items
protocol.reader_review_orchestration: the adapter must launch four fresh subagents concurrently from the canonical review packets and retain four machine-readable results
protocol.reader_review_delivery_gate: the adapter must reject finished or external delivery unless the four-way reader review aggregate is pass for the current artifact hash
protocol.reader_review_incomplete_draft_gate: after a valid third-round needs-user-decision aggregate, the adapter may show only the exact current artifact with a review-incomplete-draft receipt, unresolved issues, and a user optimization question; external actions remain blocked
protocol.external_action_preflight: the adapter must run check-action with the artifact-bound semantic review, source-backed reader aggregate, and independent judge result for high-risk work, then retain its passing action receipt immediately before publish, overwrite, or replace
protocol.delivery_precondition: the adapter must reject delivery unless verification-receipt.json has status=pass
